memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in all ADLs, walks about 2 km each day, no assistance needed.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (negative).
falls: 0 falls in the last 12 months, gait normal, timed up-and-go 9 seconds (normal).
medicines: 6 regular; polypharmacy, consider review against Beers criteria.
mood: Reports good mood, denies depressive symptoms.
carers: Meera, spouse.
goals: "Stay active and keep my garden."
